verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official W&B CLI is documented, but it lives under the W&B Models reference (docs.wandb.ai/models/ref/cli). Nothing in the pack shows Weave-specific CLI commands for traces, evaluations or scorers. Weave's agent-facing access is documented through the SDK, REST Service API, MCP server and Skills instead. Missing for 10: evidence the CLI covers Weave functionality, CLI command documentation for Weave workflows, AI-native or agent-oriented CLI usage, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
